customCurlOptions.description: Other curlOptions such as --data-binary, --ssl, -v that customers wants to include in the command

hostUrl.description: HostUrl for the uploaded file, defaults to host url of the action.

env.description: Environment for the uploaded file, defaults to env of the action.

app.description: App for the uploaded file, defaults to app of the action.

authenticationKind.description: The kind of authorization token such as OAuth, Basic, Bearer etc

authenticationToken.description: The token used to authenticate curl command

localFilePath.description: Path of the file to be uploaded.

contentLocation.description: Location of the remote file after upload. e.g. FileSourceCollection.rootUrl() + FileName

dataBinary.description: If the file has binary content.

stream.description: If the local file should be streamed for the curl request.

protocol.description: Security protocol. For files, it will use "--ssl" by default

destFileName.description: Name of the remote file after upload.

canonicalTypeName.description: Canonical type name for the import action.

title: This specs helps to generate {@link Curl} for import actions
name: CurlImportSpec
